title: Apron Chat Protocol frames
description: Informative JSON Schema for Apron Chat Protocol frames (PROTOCOL.md). PROTOCOL.md is normative. Unknown keys are allowed, since receivers ignore them (§1). Results carry no method, so validate them against <Method>Result with the request's method.

UserId.description: A user_id: not empty, with no whitespace or control characters (§2). Suggested convention: letters, digits, _ . - (Appendix A.3).

RoomId.description: A room_id: not empty, with no whitespace or control characters (§2). Suggested convention: letters, digits, _ . - (Appendix A.3).

LogId.description: A position in the server's log: decimal Unix epoch milliseconds (§2).

Ext.description: Extension data, keyed by extension name without the ext: prefix (§4). With capability ext, servers keep the ext that clients write on users, messages, and rooms, and writes merge it one level deep; without it, servers may drop it (§4.13).

User.description: A user object (§3.3). An empty value clears a field.

status.description: Current objects only. The chosen status in you: online (default), "" (none), dnd, or invisible. The shown status in every other object: online, idle, offline, dnd, or "". Clients show other values as unknown (§4.5).

seen.description: With capability status: when the shown status last became offline, in the format of a log_id. Only with a shown offline, so never in you (§4.5.2).

ext.description: Extension data (§4.13). Complete objects carry all of it; a user notification carries the keys that changed.

OwnUser.description: The user's own current object, you: it carries the chosen status, and never seen (§3.3, §4.5.2).

RecordedUser.description: A recorded user object: the from of a message or a reaction, and the user of a membership. It describes the user at the time of the record, and carries no status or seen (§3.3, §4.5).

Embed.description: An embed in a message body (§4.8).

output.description: The kept output of a terminal embed, once the output ends; set by the server (§4.8.6).

embeds.description: At most one embed of kind append (§4.8.5).

Message.description: A message snapshot or transient notice, as the server sends it (§3.5).

then.description: A tombstone carries no body and no ext (§4.4).

labels.description: A label for each sign-in scheme, such as {"external": "Acme SSO"} (§3.2).

status.description: Optional values accepted as a chosen status, with capability status; online and "" are always accepted and not listed (§4.5.1).

push.description: Each push kind's configuration, with the non-empty list of wake scopes that the server supports for it (§4.9). A top-level wake list, and webpush.key, are for clients of version 10.

key.description: For clients of version 10: the value of vapid_key (§4.9).

signature_keys.description: Ed25519 public keys: whpk_ and the base64 of the raw 32 bytes (§4.9.4).

ext.description: Data of extensions that define it on the server frame, each under its name (§4.13).

state.description: email: an unguessable value the client chooses for a proposal, returned unchanged in each link (§4.11.1); an approval may carry it, so that a short token works on another connection (§4.11.3).

code.description: external, or a webauthn finish from the passkey page: the authorization code (§4.12.2, §4.10.1).

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier of the code (§4.12.2).

redirect_uri.description: The redirect_uri that the authorization request sent (§4.12.2).

client_id.description: The client_id that the authorization request sent (§4.12.2).

status.description: The chosen status, with capability status (§4.5.1).

ext.description: With capability ext: the keys to change; the server merges them one level deep (§4.13).
With capability ext: the keys to change; the server merges them one level deep (§4.13).

MessageParams.description: Creates a message, or saves one given message_id (§3.5, §4.4).

ext.description: Extension data, an argument like the other params (§4.1, §4.13).
With capability ext: the keys to change; the server merges them one level deep (§4.13).

push_id.description: webpush: an opaque ID that the payload carries (§4.9.3).

wake.description: Selects at least one scope that the server supports for the kind (§4.9.2).

External.description: The sign-in page of an external begin (§4.12.1), or a webauthn begin's passkey page (§4.10.1).

url.description: The authorization endpoint, an absolute https URL (http only on a loopback host: localhost or a name under it, 127.0.0.0/8, or [::1]). Clients keep its query.

issuer.description: The authorization server of url; absent: the server's origin. Clients that redeem on the connection need not read it (§4.12.1).

MessageResult.description: The permanent ID of the message (§3.5.1).

PushRegisterResult.description: §4.9.4: a webhook registration's state; {} for other kinds

error.description: The last failure, with any state (§4.9.4).

Response.description: A successful reply; its result shape depends on the request's method (<Method>Result).

ErrorResponse.description: An error reply, without id when not tied to a request (§1.1).

UnknownMethod.description: A method this schema does not define. Receivers answer requests with unsupported and ignore notifications (§1).

PushPayload.description: §4.9.3: the payload of a webpush push

idle.description: false, or the seconds since nobody attended the connection (§4.5)

mute.description: true, false, or a positive number of seconds (§4.5)

StatusEvent.description: §4.5: a mute of the user's, from the server

mute.description: true, false, or a positive number of seconds (§4.5)

WebhookEvent.description: §4.9.4: the params of a webhook call, or of a verification with only server and you

latest_log_id.description: knock: no records, and none of wake, rooms, joined, left, and users
